name: cairo
title: Cairo · a ZK contract workbench
description: A Cairo/Starknet zero-knowledge contract workbench. Scaffold a Cairo 2 contract, vibecode it with an agent, build it and run its snforge tests — each contract is a self-contained Scarb project mounted as its own mod under orbit/cairo/src/mods/<name> (addressed cairo.<name>). Thin orchestration (Python stdlib) over the real toolchain already on this box: scarb 2.8.4, starknet-foundry (snforge/sncast) 0.31, universal-sierra-compiler. The 'vibecode' loop drives the headless Claude CLI, scoped to one submod, to write or edit Cairo and then verifies with build + test.
state: Contracts live in-tree as mods at orbit/cairo/src/mods/<name>/ (one Scarb project + mod.py anchor each, addressed cairo.<name>). No external state dir; scarb target/ and .snfoundry_cache/ are gitignored. The sandbox chain (starknet-devnet) keeps its state in src/.sandbox/ (gitignored, dumped every block).

endpoints.GET /cairo/api/toolchain: scarb / snforge / sncast / claude presence + versions
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/get?name=: One submod: Scarb.toml, files, build state
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/read?name=&path=: Read a file inside a submod
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/new: Scaffold a contract submod (name, desc?, template?=counter)
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/write: Write a file inside a submod (name, path, content)
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/test: snforge test (name); no name = module self-test; async=true -> job
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/vibe: Agent-edit then build + test (name, prompt, model?); async=true -> job
endpoints.note: The app self-calls the same handlers under /cairo/_api/*; /api/cairo/* is the permanent legacy alias.
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/adopt: Pull legacy root-level contracts into src/mods/ and (re)write each one's mod.py/README/config anchor
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/templates: Starter contracts new() can scaffold (counter, token, commit_reveal, merkle_allowlist)
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/abi?name=: Built contract classes: entrypoints, constructor, events, Sierra/CASM size
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/whoami: Can this caller write? {writable, via, address, owners}
endpoints.GET /cairo/<contract>/: That contract's app: its own src/mods/<c>/app/index.html, else the shared default src/templates/app.html (ABI-driven reads/writes/events)
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/app?name=: Everything the app page needs: ABI, sandbox deployment, accounts, custom-page flag (boots the devnet)
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/deploy: Declare + deploy on the local devnet (name, args={ctor arg: value}, account?). Open only if built and not already live; owner otherwise
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/call: Call an entrypoint on the sandbox (name, fn, args={name: value}, account=alice|bob|carol|dave). View -> decoded result; external -> tx + decoded events. Open
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/events?name=: Decoded events of the deployed contract, newest first
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/sandbox: Devnet status, accounts, deployments; POST action=start|stop|reset is owner-only
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/market: The bazaar: every contract with build state, ABI summary (reads/writes/events), devnet deployment, size, last touched; plus starter templates
endpoints.POST /cairo/api/fork: Copy a contract into a new mod (src, name, desc?): package, contract module, dispatchers and use-paths renamed. Owner-only
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/tutorials?id=: The LEARN track: stablecoin + Cairo lessons for beginners (no id = index + glossary)
endpoints.POST /cairo/mcp: MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0, streamable HTTP): cairo_tutorials/lesson/templates/contracts/app/read/abi/call/events/deploy/jobs open; cairo_new/write/build/test owner-only. GET = card
endpoints.GET /cairo/agents: Agent contract: the cairo helper (brains: helper = free/open, claude = owner-only via orbit/claudecode)
endpoints.POST /cairo/run/stream: Ask the helper {query, brain?, context:{contract,view,lesson,account}} -> SSE step... done{answer, actions}; every read is an MCP tool call
endpoints.GET /cairo/api/fleet: Every mod on this box with a Cairo setup (Scarb.toml -> contract|cairo, else config mentions), nearest-mod attribution; ?refresh=1 skips the 60s cache

safety: vibe() runs the Claude CLI with --permission-mode acceptEdits scoped to a single submod directory (--add-dir), so edits and scarb/snforge runs stay inside that contract's project. It uses the host Claude OAuth credentials and spends against them. No keys are deployed and nothing is sent to a live chain; sncast is present for the user to deploy by hand. Publicly routed: reads are open, but every write (write/new/vibe/build/test/clean/remove/adopt) needs a loopback request or a mod-protocol token signed by the owner (config owner, build-console private-flag owner, or CAIRO_OWNERS). The per-contract apps run on a local starknet-devnet with its public seed-0 test accounts; nothing reaches a real network. call() is open to anyone; deploy() is open only for a built contract with no live deployment; sandbox start/stop/reset is owner-only.

layout.src/mod.py: anchor: new / vibe / build / test / ... (Python stdlib)
layout.src/api/server.py: stdlib HTTP server: protocol API + job table + serves the console
layout.src/build.sh: build the console -> src/releases/<ts>, flip src/dist atomically
layout.src/templates: contract scaffold: <template>/{lib,test}.cairo.tmpl, shared Scarb.toml.tmpl, mod.py.tmpl (per-contract anchor)
layout.src/mods/<name>/: one contract MOD per dir, addressed cairo.<name>: Scarb project + mod.py (parent fns bound to this contract) + config.json + README.md
layout.src/sandbox.py: local starknet-devnet: process, ABI codec (values <-> felts), keccak selectors, deploy/call/events via sncast + JSON-RPC
layout.src/templates/app.html: the default per-contract app (one plain HTML file, no build)
layout.src/.sandbox/: devnet dump, sncast accounts file, deployments.json (gitignored)
layout.src/mods/<name>/app.json: optional Simple-view layer: labels, hidden inputs/outputs, visuals, event sentences
layout.src/tutorials.py: LEARN lessons + glossary (plain data; console, MCP and helper all read it)
layout.src/api/cairo_mcp.py: MCP server: tools = thin wrappers over mod.py fns, same gate as REST
layout.src/api/cairo_helper.py: the corner helper on the agent contract; reads via MCP tools in-process
layout.WHITEPAPER.md: the whitepaper (console: Paper view; MCP: cairo_whitepaper)

mcp.add: claude mcp add --transport http cairo http://localhost:51291/cairo/mcp
